content_sections.heading: About ISI
content_sections.text: The Indian Statistical Institute is located at 203, B.T. Road, Kolkata – 700108, and describes itself as an autonomous institute funded by MoS&PI, Government of India. This notice is for part-time contractual specialist doctors and a counsellor at its Headquarters in Kolkata, to attend OPD sessions on fixed dates and times.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Chief Executive (A&F), Indian Statistical Institute, 203, B. T. Road, Kolkata – 700108

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The four positions add up to a total of 4. Qualification: candidates having MBBS, MS/DO/DNB in Ophthalmology shall be considered. Experience: at least 3 years for MS/DNB; at least 5 years for DO. Working hours: to attend OPD for 02 days per week on fixed dates and time. Each OPD session is of 3 hours duration. Qualification: candidates having MBBS, MS/DLO/DNB in ENT shall be considered. Experience: at least 3 years for MS/DNB; at least 5 years for DLO. Working hours: to attend OPD for 02 days per week on fixed dates and time. Each OPD session is of 3 hours duration. Qualification: candidates having MBBS, DPM/MD/DNB in Psychiatry. Experience: at least 3 years for MD/DNB; at least 5 years for DPM. Working hours: to attend OPD for 02 days per week on fixed dates and time. Each OPD session is of 3 hours duration. Pay: Rs 30000/- per month and Rs.2500 per session for Sensitization Programme. Qualification: candidates having Masters in Clinical Psychology/ Applied Psychology. Experience: 02 years' relevant experience in counseling late adolescents and adults in an Academic Institution/ hospital setting or any other mental health clinic. Preference will be given to candidates having RCI registration. Working hours: to attend OPD for 03 days per week on fixed dates and time. Each OPD session is of 2 hours duration. Age: 65 years or below as on the cut off date. The cut-off date for eligibility is the normal closing date for receipt of applications. Only the matriculation/SSC certificate issued by the concerned education board is accepted as proof of date of birth. Only Indian Nationals may apply. Work experience in Institutes of National Importance like IITs/IISERs/IISc/NITs and other similar Central Govt. Institutions is desirable. For all posts, change of OPD dates is allowed only if there is an Institute holiday on the dates fixed. The prescribed qualifications and experience are the bare minimum; possessing them does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. Candidates should read the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. The positions are part-time contractual, initially for One (01) year, likely to be extended further based on requirement and performance. The services of the selected candidate(s) are liable to be terminated by serving a notice of 30 days in writing by either side, unless otherwise agreed to by the Institute and the selected candidate(s). The other terms and conditions of service are such as may be specified by the appointing authority in the letter of appointment. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of all credentials in proof of age, academic qualifications, category, experience, Awards & Honours; without them no weightage is given for the credentials claimed. Photograph and signature; applications without self-attested copies of all relevant certificates, documents, photograph and signature are summarily rejected. For the interview: all documents in original for verification, and a set of self-attested copies for submission along with two (02) recent passport size photographs. Without these, candidates will not be allowed to appear in the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through the recommendations of the Selection Committee based on performance in an interview. The interview is intended to test various aspects of personality quotient, domain knowledge and suitability of the candidates for ready deployment for job/assignment with relevant experience. If the number of applications is large, the short-listing Committee of the Institute will adopt criteria to restrict the number of candidates called for interview. It may use higher educational qualifications than the minimum, or higher experience in the relevant field than the minimum, or both. Candidates should therefore give details of all higher qualifications and experience with documentary evidence. Shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interview before the Selection Committee on a given date and time, conveyed through the email ID given in the application. The Institute will not entertain any request for change of date, time or venue, and no interview will be conducted through VC mode. The Selection Committee will prepare a merit list based on interview performance and, if required, may draw a waiting list. Candidates should keep a regular watch on the ISI website for information on the selection process.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ISI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are four positions, one each for Ophthalmology (Eye), Otorhinolaryngology (ENT), Psychiatry and Psychological Counsellor.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ISI Kolkata posts?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Institute within 30 days of publication of the advertisement in the Employment News, about 27 November 2026 if counted from the notice date of 28 October 2026. The notice does not print the Employment News publication date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the specialist doctor posts?
faq.answer: Ophthalmology needs MBBS, MS/DO/DNB; ENT needs MBBS, MS/DLO/DNB; Psychiatry needs MBBS, DPM/MD/DNB. Experience of at least 3 years (MS/DNB/MD) or 5 years (DO/DLO/DPM) is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Psychological Counsellor post?
faq.answer: Masters in Clinical Psychology/ Applied Psychology, with 02 years' relevant experience in counseling late adolescents and adults in an Academic Institution, hospital setting or any other mental health clinic. Preference is given to candidates with RCI registration.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 65 years or below as on the cut off date, which is the normal closing date for receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay for these posts?
faq.answer: The Ophthalmology and ENT specialists get Rs 30000/- per month. The Psychiatrist gets Rs 30000/- per month plus Rs.2500 per session for Sensitization Programme. The Psychological Counsellor gets Rs 2500/- per session for counselling and Rs. 2500/- per session for any sensitization programme.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that there is no application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for ISI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the complete application in the prescribed format with all documents in a sealed cover by Speed Post to the Chief Executive (A&F), Indian Statistical Institute, 203, B. T. Road, Kolkata – 700108.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is based on performance in a personal interview before the Selection Committee, with a merit list and possible waiting list. If applications are many, shortlisting is done on higher qualifications or experience than the minimum.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job, and is TA/DA paid for the interview?
faq.answer: The posts are part-time contractual, initially for one year and likely to be extended based on requirement and performance. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
